challenges.title: Select All
challenges.question: Write a query to display all records from the Student table.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student;

challenges.title: Select One Column
challenges.question: Display only the Name column.
challenges.expected: SELECT Name FROM Student;

challenges.title: WHERE Clause
challenges.question: Display students whose Marks are greater than 80.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE Marks > 80;

challenges.title: AND Operator
challenges.question: Display students with Marks > 80 AND City='Delhi'.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE Marks > 80 AND City='Delhi';

challenges.title: OR Operator
challenges.question: Display students from Delhi OR Mumbai.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE City='Delhi' OR City='Mumbai';

challenges.title: ORDER BY
challenges.question: Sort students by Marks in descending order.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student ORDER BY Marks DESC;

challenges.title: COUNT
challenges.question: Count the total number of students.
challenges.expected: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student;

challenges.title: MAX
challenges.question: Find the highest marks.
challenges.expected: SELECT MAX(Marks) FROM Student;

challenges.title: MIN
challenges.question: Find the lowest marks.
challenges.expected: SELECT MIN(Marks) FROM Student;

challenges.title: AVG
challenges.question: Find the average marks.
challenges.expected: SELECT AVG(Marks) FROM Student;

challenges.title: SUM
challenges.question: Find the total marks of all students.
challenges.expected: SELECT SUM(Marks) FROM Student;

challenges.title: DISTINCT
challenges.question: Display distinct cities.
challenges.expected: SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Student;

challenges.title: LIKE
challenges.question: Display names starting with 'A'.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE Name LIKE 'A%';

challenges.title: BETWEEN
challenges.question: Display students with marks between 60 and 90.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE Marks BETWEEN 60 AND 90;

challenges.title: IN
challenges.question: Display students from Delhi or Raipur using IN.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student WHERE City IN ('Delhi','Raipur');

challenges.title: CREATE TABLE
challenges.question: Create a Student table with RollNo, Name and Marks.
challenges.expected: CREATE TABLE Student(RollNo INT, Name VARCHAR(30), Marks INT);

challenges.title: INSERT
challenges.question: Insert one student record.
challenges.expected: INSERT INTO Student VALUES(1,'Amit',95);

challenges.title: UPDATE
challenges.question: Update Amit's marks to 98.
challenges.expected: UPDATE Student SET Marks=98 WHERE Name='Amit';

challenges.title: DELETE
challenges.question: Delete the record where RollNo=1.
challenges.expected: DELETE FROM Student WHERE RollNo=1;

challenges.title: GROUP BY
challenges.question: Display average marks city-wise.
challenges.expected: SELECT City, AVG(Marks) FROM Student GROUP BY City;

challenges.title: HAVING
challenges.question: Display cities having average marks greater than 80.
challenges.expected: SELECT City, AVG(Marks) FROM Student GROUP BY City HAVING AVG(Marks)>80;

challenges.title: INNER JOIN
challenges.question: Display student names with their department names.
challenges.expected: SELECT Student.Name, Department.DeptName FROM Student INNER JOIN Department ON Student.DeptID=Department.DeptID;

challenges.title: LEFT JOIN
challenges.question: Display all students and matching departments.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student LEFT JOIN Department ON Student.DeptID=Department.DeptID;

challenges.title: RIGHT JOIN
challenges.question: Display all departments and matching students.
challenges.expected: SELECT * FROM Student RIGHT JOIN Department ON Student.DeptID=Department.DeptID;

challenges.title: SQL Master
challenges.question: Display the second highest marks from the Student table.
challenges.expected: SELECT MAX(Marks) FROM Student WHERE Marks < (SELECT MAX(Marks) FROM Student);
